newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian central bank September reserves dip.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian central bank September reserves dip.

text.p: The central bank of Lithuania said on Tuesday its official reserves dipped to $835.9 million in September from $852.5 million the previous month, the first fall for several months.
The reserves had been steadily gaining as Lithuania recovered from a banking crisis at the end of last year and hit a high point in August.
The central bank has to keep enough foreign currency reserves to back the litas currency at four to one dollar.
